scope: Контракт native тормозного oracle без интегрирования движения POEZD. Только статическое чтение PE/исходников; native не загружался и не исполнялся. Новая LTD становится единственным владельцем координат, скоростей, ускорений и сцепных сил.

oracle.relocation_rule: Материализовать полный expected body из original_body_hex: к каждому перечисленному UInt32 прибавить loadedBase−preferredBase по modulo2^32. Сравнить все байты RAM после только явно разрешённых owned overlays. Mask дан для диагностики; не оставлять relocation words непроверенными.
oracle.ABI: void BrakeProducer(); stack arguments отсутствуют, обычный RET, EAX/ECX/EDX и x87 volatile. Noargs cdecl/StdCall одинаковы на x86. Никакого Self/Delphi instance. Единственные CALL тела — CRT fabs RVA114D0, два раза на элемент; FPU stack после полного прохода сбалансирован.
oracle.output: B[i] at loadedBase+1D0AC; signed nonpositive capacity, units10kN. MagnitudeN=−B[i]*10000. Producer использует Abs(V), поэтому знак движения не меняет знак B. Направление трения и удержание около нуля назначает LTD.
oracle.model_side_effects: Тело читает inputs/config/counts, пишет локальный стек и B[0..75]. Не интегрирует X/V/A/couplers. Отдельный текущий perPad hook читает owned perPadSource, а диагностический observer может писать свои capture buffers.

configuration.motion_total: 76 units,6200t,8+300=308axles; locomotive is one200t LTD body.
configuration.pneumatic_mapping: 77 pneumatic records: index0=first100t BVR section, index1=second100t BVR section, then75 wagons. Public cars[0] is first BVR, cars[n>=1] maps pneumatic table index n+1. The second BVR is not another LTD vehicle.
configuration.padding: Data arrays have capacity150 even though76 are configured. Snapshot/restore at least exact used304 bytes; whole600-byte buffers are acceptable if ownership/capacity verified. Do not read a151st element or use77 pneumatic count as76 motion count.

pressure_units.source: TrainerAir.Reservoir.Gauge=(PressurePa−101325)/98066.5 at TrainerAirNetwork.cs:13,21. Thus native interface scalar is gauge kgf/cm²; legacy field names ending Bar are not a reason to multiply by1e5.
pressure_units.wagons: Pass cars[n].TC Single+4 for n1..75, once each, through exported SetTorm(Psend,76).
pressure_units.loco: Current candidate SelectNativeLocomotiveBrakeInput uses four physical Cylinder[s,b].Gauge, s,b=0,1; Psend_loco=4*sum(Pbogie),16 cylinders total. Loc+13 is ONLY section0/bogie0 gauge and is not the four-bogie pressure average. Legacy LocTC*8 was default fallback before the candidate hook.
pressure_units.per_pad: For every bogie: k=Acm2*Pbogie*4.4*0.00085; base contribution8*0.031*k*(k+6.25)/(k+1.92). Sum four bogies, set perPadSource to negative sum. Native cast-iron speed factor remains (abs(vms)+27.78)/(abs(vms)+5.56). Do not replace unequal pressures by one total pressure inside this nonlinear law.
pressure_units.geometry: Candidate updates kind2 area to pi*20.3²/4 cm² and both kind2 levers to8.8, preserving wagon kind1 geometry. Calibration of material-specific locomotive law, return spring and0.85 efficiency remains explicitly unaccepted.

friction_formula.literal_native_formula: K=A[kind]*Psend*Lever[FTk,kind]*0.00085; B=−phi0[FTk]*K*(K+c1[FTk])/(K+c2[FTk])*(abs(Vms)+c3[FTk])/(abs(Vms)+c4[FTk]). B is the native10kN force capacity, not directly a SI pad force. Preserve legacy numeric law rather than silently reinterpret its0.00085 factor.
friction_formula.scope: FTk0/FTk1 identifies retained mathematical branches and current host configuration. No newly accepted normative brake-force calibration is claimed.

owned_overlay.cave_semantics: PUSHFD; if [EBP−10]!=0 skip replacement; otherwise pop original x87 base and FLD Double[perPadSource]; POPFD; replay FMUL[EBP−C],MOV EDX,[EBP−10]; JMP1EC1.
owned_overlay.guard: Only allow this overlay when private owner says perPadConnected and exact host-owned pointers are live. Validate exact six entry bytes, exact27 cave bytes including source pointer and return displacement, executable committed cave, readable8-byte source, source finiteness, module/thread/lifetime. Do not accept arbitrary JMP or first-observed bytes.
owned_overlay.observer_conflict: TrainerNativeBrakeObserver may independently own store1EC1 (inside full body). Reject it unless a separately verified known owner API supplies its exact overlay; do not weaken entire bodyguard. Production currently needs only perPad overlay.
owned_overlay.source_borrow: If oracle stages perPadSource for a query, snapshot and restore its8 bytes under the same owner guard, or explicitly keep original SelectNativeLocomotiveBrakeInput ownership; no foreign memory writes.

borrow_call_restore: On the single synchronous owner thread, require loaded path/SHA, module pin/lifetime, counts76/76/1, configuration kind/FTk, complete relocated codeguard+known cave. Reject NaN/Infinity and illegal pressures/speeds before any write.

Call existing SelectNativeLocomotiveBrakeInput to obtain aggregate locomotive pressure and correct perPad source; publish exactly76 SetTorm inputs in order0..75, verifying cursor0 before and after. For a completely reversible oracle snapshot/restore Psend[0..75], cursor, perPadSource too, since SetTorm changes them.

Snapshot V_group[0..75] and B[0..75] (or validated whole150 arrays); stage one coherent LTD velocity vector in m/s; call ONLY BrakeProducer1DBC; copy76 finite nonpositive force capacities and convert to positive newtons for LTD.

In independent finally blocks restore borrowed V/B and any staged inputs/source/cursor even on native/managed failure. Do not return stale capacities if call or cleanup fails. Keep module pinned through cleanup; require owner/thread/data lifetime for restoration.

Do not call Poezd1258, ForceAll19F4, coordinate update1FAC, rolling1EE8 or a native model step to obtain B. New LTD alone performs movement. Old Poezd invokes19F4 both before and inside predictor/corrector; for closer speed dependence the LTD oracle can be queried per force evaluation with pressure held during the external0.1s pneumatic frame. If sampled only once per frame, document that approximation.

LTD applies friction opposite each vehicle velocity and static holding at zero from the capacity; a negative native B is not an instruction to accelerate backward. Do not add native rolling/grade/curve/brake resistance twice.

get_cur_val.coordinates: Producer1FAC: xFront[0]=−q[0]; xFront[n]=xFront[n−1]−length[n−1]−q[n]. Head position is front reference, not centre. For centre-based LTD: Reset centre0=headFront−L0/2, publish xFront[n]=centre[n]+Ln/2 on the existing positive route axis. Out5 is −absolute head position for n0 and relative inter-vehicle q for following nodes; not a universal exported deformation.
get_cur_val.coupler_index_sign: S[n] is coupling ahead of vehicle n; S[0] is the free leading boundary (zero, BSS; native coupling loop starts1). S[1] is loco↔first wagon, ...,S[75] is wagon74↔wagon75. Positive S is tension/pull, negative is compression; equation a[n]=(S[n]−S[n+1]+external[n])/scaledMass[n] at1627–1652. For a75-link LTD array: cars[0].coupler=0; cars[n>0].coupler=link[n−1] with conversion sign if LTD stores compression positive, divide newtons by10000.

New LTD reset/free-play convention must be explicit; do not accidentally add half locomotive length to route or double-count slack.

production_consumers_to_migrate.action: Retain POEZD setup only as oracle configuration if desired. Replace MotionCycle movement/state reads and SetInitialSpeed reset with LTD. Publish all76 vehicle states atomically.
ReadAutovedenieConsistVelocity must use LTD signed mass-weighted mean, not stale native readTrain: (200*v0+80*sum(v1..75))/6200.

StartAtRouteStation resets LTD before publishing head fields and markup ResetPosition; routeGeneration/boundary/limits/routeview remain coherent. ConfigureNativeRoute may keep old profile for oracle-only library but actual LTD grade/curve provider must use centre-based geometry consistently.

Legacy mass/material/charging calibration checks and historic brake model identity must remain unaccepted or be replaced by new LTD calibration. Initializing POEZD arrays is not proof of the new movement model.
Retain geometry and perPad ownership for native brake oracle; do not remove its guarded cleanup while oracle can still call the native body.
Telemetry/logging consume published cars position/accel/coupler and head speed; do not leave these as old POEZD values.

test_fixture_migration: All probes that call stateTrain/readTrain or assume native MotionCycle, GetCurVal first-step publication, native predictor velocities or original BrakeObserver capture counts need explicit LTD-aware fixtures. Keep old receipts historical; do not reinterpret old POEZD passing results as new LTD acceptance.
